construction.implementation_origin: Newly authored isolated deterministic Python reference

shared_schema.input: Strict envelope: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, season, assets, meters, meter_readings_csv, telemetry, emissions, tickets, config. Unknown fields rejected.
shared_schema.assets: Unique fictitious asset_id, kind substation/transformer/feeder, boolean critical, connected_to referencing declared assets; directed synthetic topology.
shared_schema.meter_readings_csv: Exact header meter_id,timestamp,interval_minutes,consumption_kwh; aware ISO timestamps; 15/30/60 minute intervals; finite nonnegative consumption; unique meter/timestamp.
shared_schema.telemetry: SCADA-style JSON records: asset_id, timestamp, voltage_v, status normal/alarm/offline.
shared_schema.emissions: asset_id, finite nonnegative value, unit kgCO2e or tCO2e, nonempty source. Units and provenance retained; no conversion.
shared_schema.tickets: Unique ticket_id, text, asset_ids, meter_ids, nullable outage_report. Report requires reported_at, nonnegative integer affected_customers and all three explicit boolean safety flags.
shared_schema.config: Fixed categories outage/grid/meter/general with configurable keywords, category_priority P1-P4, team and accountable_owner routes, and safety_rules.
shared_schema.output: One status=ok JSON envelope with schema_version, synthetic, season, triaged tickets, aggregate meter readings, opaque-reference grid topology, telemetry, emissions and protection notice. Input-order ticket/asset/meter references are local to the envelope. Errors: status=error and safe message.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate() layer called by triage() and CLI. CSV and JSON records checked before routing; bounded lists and input sizes; duplicate JSON keys rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality only: validated normalized entities -> deterministic categorization -> safety-constrained priority -> configured accountable routing -> identifier-minimized result.

behavior.category_precedence: Structured outage, then configured outage keywords, then linked nonnormal telemetry, then case-insensitive whole-word configured keywords in grid/meter/general order, then general fallback.
behavior.safety: P1 highest urgency. life_threatening and downed_line require P1; critical_service requires P2 or stronger. Config cannot weaken these floors. Free-text outage without structured safety assessment receives P1.
behavior.critical_identifier_protection: All raw asset/meter/ticket identifiers omitted from output; critical IDs also scrubbed case-insensitively from display strings. No raw ticket text echoed, no raw input persisted. Per-envelope opaque references are not authentication or encryption.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: Fictitious winter substation-feeder topology, offline substation, healthy feeder, winter evening 1.8 and 2.1 kWh half-hour heating consumption, synthetic emissions provenance.
behavior.determinism: No clock, random numbers, provider calls or external services.

included: Single CLI and library entry point
Synthetic interval CSV and SCADA JSON
excluded: Live model or optional model integration

coverage: CLI success, file errors, usage errors and malformed JSON
